description: Requires a JWT. Same authority as room_config_get. sets = up to 8 {key: value}: autopilot, auto_raids, chatter (on/off); raid_minutes, raids_per_hour, quiet_minutes, summaries_per_hour, dropins_per_hour (numbers, clamped to the /manage bands); buybot (on/off), buybot_token (a Solana mint), buybot_symbol (ticker), buybot_min (USD, 1-100000), buybot_spotlights (on/off); shield, x_link_guard (on/off). Returns each result and the room's settings after.
name: room_config_set
title: Change a Telegram room's settings
